description: This file defines functions and utilities related to resizing tensors in the PyTorch library, including output resizing, storage resizing, and shape/stride management.

methods.name: resize_output
methods.description: Resizes the output tensor to the specified shape, issuing warnings if resizing occurs.

methods.name: resize_output_symint
methods.description: Resizes output tensor with support for symbolic integers.

methods.name: resize_output_check
methods.description: Checks if resizing is needed and issues warnings.

methods.name: resize_output_check_symint
methods.description: Checks if symbolic shape resizing is needed.

methods.name: resize_bytes_meta
methods.description: Resizes storage bytes with symbolic integers.

methods.name: maybe_resize_storage_cpu
methods.description: Attempts to resize storage on CPU if necessary.

methods.name: resize_impl_cpu_
methods.description: Implementation for resizing tensor on CPU.

methods.name: maybe_convert_symint
methods.description: Converts symbolic integers to concrete types.

methods.name: checkInBoundsForStorage
methods.description: Checks if the tensor shape and stride are within storage bounds.

methods.name: checkSetStorage
methods.description: Validates and sets storage for a tensor.

methods.name: setStrided
methods.description: Sets tensor sizes, strides, and storage offset with validation.
